> **★ Best for**

> - educational tools  
> - edge deployments  
> - math-focused tutoring agents
Meta’s efficient multimodal MoE model for reasoning, coding, image understanding, and long-context tasks.
OpenAI’s open-weight models designed for powerful reasoning, agentic tasks, and versatile developer use cases.

Google's state-of-the-art open-weight multimodal model built for reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows. Uses a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 26B total parameters and only ~4B active per token, delivering excellent quality while remaining highly efficient. Supports text and image inputs, function calling, structured outputs, and advanced reasoning capabilities.

Alibaba's latest general-purpose reasoning model optimized for coding, tool use and agentic workflows. Delivers strong performance across instruction following, software development, and structured output generation while remaining efficient to deploy.
